xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order in Original issued by Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Surat
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Company had given its goods on Job work to Shree Shyam Syntex, who in turn got the same work done by Laxmi Impex. Laxmi Impex completed the work using the Capital Goods brought under 100% EOU Scheme. The owner of Shree Shaym Syntex and Laxmi Impex was same. The facts were not known to the Company and accordingly the Company was alleged to be liable for penalty under Rule 26 of Central Excise Rule, 2001.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Imposition of penalty amount of Rs 50,000. Except the penalty amount, There is no impact on the financial, operation or other activities of the Company due to levy of the said penalty
